original_strict_reveal.protocol_defect: the strict model fixed the leading axis-difference amplitude to zero, although the rank-two T fit never imposed or inferred that condition

repaired_primary_score.fit: fit both complex A-mode amplitudes on d1..4 at the already frozen T roots
repaired_primary_score.nuisance: leading A-mode amplitude is free in every hand-charge channel
repaired_primary_score.tested_relation: second A-mode amplitude equals ((1-q)/(1+q)) times the second T-mode amplitude
repaired_primary_score.covariance: delete-one covariance with roots and all amplitudes refit in each deletion
repaired_primary_score.heldout: fit only the leading A amplitude on d1..4 under each q and predict A(d5)

root_phase_alphabet.logical_boundary: the root phase cannot by itself name the state; a non-Z5 internal account requires a compound or non-generator transfer step

decision_rule: a q candidate closes only when both its second-mode amplitude score and d5 heldout have p>=0.01
if only q=1 closes, reject a spatial C4 direction character for the second state
if exactly one q=+i or q=-i closes, retain that spatial C4 direction character
if multiple candidates close, report unresolved
if none closes, report that no single shared direction character describes the second mode
claim_boundary: This repair is explicitly post-strict-null and is not represented as prospectively frozen before any x/y reveal.
The repair removes an unjustified nuisance restriction; it does not reselect rank, roots, phase alphabets, or candidates.
Unrestricted per-channel q values are diagnostics only.
